zh.title: 发布说明
items: **0.1.0-rc.25** 基于 RC24，修复大日志恢复、日志重复写入和对话加载失败；保留 RC24 的权限、任务协调与核验行为。正式版仍为 0.0.18。

zh.title: 修复与优化
items: 主 Bot 默认读取用户输入与正式回复，子任务的执行过程按需打开。任务摘要仍来自宿主事实，不能代替权限、工具结果或证据。
对话、任务卡与回复详情分别加载。任务状态读取失败或新消息刷新失败时，已有对话继续可读；首次加载失败明确提示，并可重试。
协调日志使用增量事件与分段存储，避免反复写入全部累计用量和进展；用量回执保持精确去重，大载荷保留原文与校验引用。
大日志在后台分块恢复，派生索引缺失时可重建。恢复校验来源、持久记录与租约；未知工具结果不自动重做，损坏或缺失的已提交记录不会被当成空任务继续执行。
修正完成回复的详情定位、异步问题的自由输入关联，以及窗口变窄时回复详情入口越界的问题。
同步中英发布说明、升级文档和网站更新日志。

zh.title: 数据保留与升级
items: 升级保留任务身份、对话、证据与原协调日志；新格式在取得项目独占租约并完成恢复校验后启用，不清空历史或重开任务。
**发布不会安装或重启当前应用。** 安装升级需要退出旧进程，不是热更新。正在执行任务时先保持旧应用运行，等待模型调用、工具、核验与受管后台工作自然结束后再安排升级。
升级前备份完整数据根，并同步升级使用同一数据的 Desktop、CLI/TUI 与 Gateway。不要让旧版宿主接管已经启用新日志格式的数据。回退到不支持新格式的版本必须恢复完整升级前备份；保留的旧日志不是升级后的最新执行状态。

zh.title: 验收范围与限制
items: 发布候选执行全量测试、源码桌面交互与逐图审查，并使用候选安装包中的实际模块在隔离副本上验证恢复和数据保留。实现者自审不等于独立审查。
受控认知不代表所有云模型的质量或时延。完整读屏、Windows/Linux 交互安装与长期日用不在本轮验收范围内。
单条历史记录支持到 64 MiB；过程详情按选定回合加载。更细过程分页和超大正文分片仍有后续工作。

en.title: Release notes
items: **0.1.0-rc.25**, based on RC24, fixes large-log recovery, repeated journal writes and conversation loading failures while retaining RC24 access, coordination and verification behavior. Stable remains 0.0.18.

en.title: Fixes and improvements
items: The main Bot reads public user inputs and final replies by default; child execution details load on demand. Task summaries remain host facts and do not replace permissions, tool results or evidence.
Load conversations, task cards and reply details independently. Existing messages remain readable after task-status or refresh failures; initial failures show an explicit retry action.

Use incremental, segmented coordination events instead of repeatedly writing accumulated usage and progress. Usage receipts retain exact deduplication; large payloads retain their content and verified references.

Recover large journals in bounded background reads and rebuild missing derived indexes. Recovery checks source identity, durable records and ownership. Unknown tool outcomes are not automatically repeated, and missing committed records cannot become an empty executable task.
Correct completed-reply detail anchors, free-text answers to asynchronous questions and reply-detail overflow when narrowing a window.
Update bilingual release notes, upgrade documentation and the website changelog.

en.title: Data preservation and upgrading
items: Preserve task identities, conversations, evidence and the original coordination journal. Activate the new format only after acquiring exclusive project ownership and completing recovery checks; do not reset history or recreate tasks.

**Publishing does not install or restart the current app.** Installation requires the old process to exit. Keep it running until active model requests, tools, verification and managed background work have finished naturally before scheduling an upgrade.

Back up the complete data root and upgrade Desktop, CLI/TUI and Gateway that share it together. Older hosts must not take ownership after activation. Downgrading to an incompatible version requires the complete pre-upgrade backup; the retained legacy journal is not the latest executable state.

en.title: Validation scope and limitations
items: The release candidate runs full regression, source desktop interactions and screenshot review, plus recovery and preservation checks using actual candidate-package modules on isolated copies. Implementer self-review is not independent review.

Controlled cognition does not establish quality or latency for every cloud model. Full screen-reader coverage, interactive Windows/Linux installation and long-term use remain outside this acceptance scope.
Individual history records support up to 64 MiB. Process details load one selected turn at a time; finer pagination and oversized-body chunking remain follow-up work.
